note: V90Demodulator's five phase entries and three diagnostics accessors, against t_v90dataph.  Three of the entries are near-copies of each other -- enterRRN and enterFPE share the deadline line verbatim -- so those anchors are widened with the preceding statement, which differs.  Finding F347's remedy applied to a smaller case.  THE THREE CONST MEMBERS CARRY NO "fn" FIELD, and that is tools/anchorcheck.py's limitation rather than a choice: its definition index requires the closing parenthesis to be followed by `{`, and a const member has ` const` between them, so `getAT_UD`, `getRbsPattern` and `indicateRemoteRateReneg` are invisible to it and an `fn` naming any of them reads as `names no function`.  The field is opt-in, so dropping it costs only rule 2's cross-check on those eleven anchors; rule 1's uniqueness check still applies to all of them and every one of the eleven is verified unique.  No const member anywhere in the tree can use `fn` today.
